map.由物距与曲率半径，按 f=R/2 与 1/f = 1/u + 1/v 计算像距与: Compute the image distance and magnification from the object distance and radius of curvature using f = R/2 and 1/f = 1/u + 1/v.
map.由物距算像距与对称性。: Compute image distance and symmetry from object distance.
map.多镜夹角成像数（360/θ−1）。: Number of images for two mirrors at an angle (360/theta - 1).
map.：物距镜 30cm → 虚像距镜 30cm、等大正立，像与物关于镜面对称。: : object 30 cm from the mirror -> virtual image 30 cm behind the mirror, same size and upright, with image and object symmetric about the mirror plane.
map.：两镜夹 60° → 成像数=360/60−1=5 个；夹角越小像越多，趋近平行: : two mirrors at 60 degrees -> image count = 360/60 - 1 = 5; the smaller the angle the more images, approaching infinity as the mirrors become parallel.
map.镜中像左右反吗？: Is the mirror image reversed left and right?
map.是前后反（深度镜像）而非左右反，习惯说「左右反」是相对自身的前后翻转。: It is front-back reversed (depth mirroring) rather than left-right reversed; saying "left-right reversed" refers to front-back flipping relative to oneself.
map.夹角成像公式？: Imaging count formula for an angle?
map.整数夹角 θ 时像数=360/θ−1（θ 整除 360），否则取 floor。: For an integer angle theta the image count = 360/theta - 1 (theta divides 360), otherwise take the floor.
